name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet roughly shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Sit the hips back and down while keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, or as far as is comfortable.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
technique_considerations: Keep heels on the floor throughout.
Let knees track in line with your toes.
